requirements.description: Review antenna, component RF ratings, zero-bias loading, mismatch peaks, DC isolation and exact reference adaptation. Default values do not establish matching or system ESD protection.

Review connector-first ESD interception and shortest ground return, tuning/DC block lands, surface-only feed and continuous adjacent ground. Authored distance bounds do not establish return inductance.
Qualify complete launches, all segments and pad discontinuities on selected stackup with component parasitics, fabrication tolerances and actual return copper.
Measure installed matching/loss, receiver or transmitter performance, coexistence and system ESD. Verify all selected bands and operating states.
